title: Whole Turkey (frozen)

adjustment.analysis: The baseline median of 4.5 is consistent with recent low sales (3-5 units) at the current price. No events, promotions, or price changes are scheduled. Past promotions show high variability with noise-adjusted effects near 1.0, and post-promotion weeks show no lasting lift. Mother's Day (2026-05-04) saw only 3 units, below baseline, suggesting limited seasonal pull. The product has no clear trend, and recent weeks show no sustained uplift. The classical model correctly identifies no driver. No evidence supports moving from 1.0.
